9z.zh: T 方分兵进点占 87%，高于其他队伍的 61%；拖后进攻仅占 7%，低于其他队伍的 26%，更少把进攻留到后段。
9z.en: The T side favors split hits at 87% versus the other teams' 61%. Late hits account for just 7% versus their 26%, showing less reliance on delayed attacks.

b8.zh: T 方先假打再转点仅占 2%，低于其他队伍的 16%。最常用的 A 点爆弹为丛林烟、楼梯烟和 A二楼脚手架处的火，7 次赢下 4 次。
b8.en: The T side rarely fakes before the hit: 2% versus the other teams' 16%. Its go-to A execute uses Jungle smoke, Stairs smoke and a Palace scaffolding molotov, winning 4 of 7 attempts.

betboom.zh: BETBOOM 的 T 方明显偏向 A 点：进攻 A 点占 91%，高于其他队伍的 65%；B 点仅占 9%，低于其他队伍的 35%。
betboom.en: BETBOOM's T side heavily favors A, attacking it in 91% of rounds versus the other teams' 65%. B accounts for just 9% versus their 35%.

furia.zh: FURIA 的 T 方有摸边的进攻占 44%，高于其他队伍的 23%，进攻时更常保留侧翼活动。
furia.en: FURIA's T side includes a lurker on 44% of hits versus the other teams' 23%, making activity away from the main hit a more frequent feature.

lgcy.zh: LGCY 的 CT 方在进攻开始后及时回防的回合仅占 7%，低于其他队伍的 32%，及时回防较少。
lgcy.en: LGCY's CT side rotates in time after a hit begins in just 7% of rounds versus the other teams' 32%, with timely support less common.

m80.zh: T 方先假打再转点占 30%，高于其他队伍的 14%，更常在进点前用假打改变进攻方向。
m80.en: The T side fakes before the hit in 30% of rounds versus the other teams' 14%, more often changing the attack direction after a fake.

mibr.zh: MIBR 的 T 方最常用 A 点爆弹，以丛林烟、楼梯火配合，6 次进攻赢下 3 次。
mibr.en: MIBR's T side favors an A execute with Jungle smoke and Stairs molotov, winning 3 of 6 attempts.

mnglz.zh: MNGLZ 的 T 方最常用 A 点爆弹，以丛林烟、楼梯火配合，5 次进攻赢下 1 次。
mnglz.en: MNGLZ's T side favors an A execute with Jungle smoke and Stairs molotov, winning 1 of 5 attempts.

monte.zh: Monte 的 T 方最常由 AZUWU 摸边，7 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
monte.en: Monte's T side usually has AZUWU lurking, with him on the other side or away from the hit on 7 attacks.

mouz.zh: MOUZ 的 CT 方在进攻开始后及时回防的回合占 50%，高于其他队伍的 30%，更常及时补上防守。
mouz.en: MOUZ's CT side rotates in time after a hit begins in 50% of rounds versus the other teams' 30%, bringing timely defensive support more often.

pain.zh: paiN 的 T 方快攻占 37%，高于其他队伍的 17%，进攻节奏更积极。CT 默认站位 A3 M1 B1 占 28% 的枪局，胜率 67%。
pain.en: paiN's T side fast-hits in 37% of rounds versus the other teams' 17%, favoring a quicker pace. Its default CT setup A3 M1 B1 covers 28% of gun rounds with a 67% win rate.

parivision.zh: PARIVISION 的 CT 方开局前压占 69%，高于其他队伍的 39%，防守更常主动向前展开。
parivision.en: PARIVISION's CT side pushes early in 69% of rounds versus the other teams' 39%, more often taking a forward defensive posture.

spirit.zh: Spirit 的 T 方最常用丛林烟、楼梯烟和 A二楼脚手架处的火爆弹 A 点，7 次赢下 4 次。CT 开局前压仅占 12%，低于其他队伍的 42%。
spirit.en: Spirit's go-to T execute hits A with Jungle smoke, Stairs smoke and a Palace scaffolding molotov, winning 4 of 7 attempts. Its CT side pushes early in just 12% of rounds versus the other teams' 42%.

the-mongolz.zh: The MongolZ 的 CT 默认站位 A3 M1 B1 占 28% 的枪局，胜率 57%。
the-mongolz.en: The MongolZ's default CT setup A3 M1 B1 covers 28% of gun rounds with a 57% win rate.

tyloo.zh: TYLOO 的 T 方拖后进攻仅占 4%，低于其他队伍的 26%；CT 开局前压占 67%，高于其他队伍的 39%。
tyloo.en: TYLOO's T side uses late hits in just 4% of rounds versus the other teams' 26%. Its CT side pushes early in 67% versus their 39%, showing frequent early defensive aggression.
